name: Not Like Us
instruction: Make choices from the audience, task, real content, and local system. Avoid unearned generator defaults. Use rules/WRITING.md, rules/DESIGN.md, and the matching tools folder. Local project guidance wins.
never: generic purple gradients or aurora blobs
Inter, Geist, glass panels, or rounded cards by reflex
centered hero plus three cards plus CTA page formulas
decorative pills, icon tiles, fake metrics, or fake testimonials
throat-clearing, binary contrast slogans, or vague consensus
rule-of-three filler, synonym cycling, recap endings, or em dashes
a claim that one visual or verbal tell proves AI authorship
prefer: real content, edge cases, empty states, and error states
deliberate typography, restrained color, and hierarchy before decoration
plain claims, concrete nouns, named sources, and varied sentence rhythm
human review against the portability test
